dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I love Bangkok. It's the most interesting city I've ever lived in.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈlʌv ˈbæŋkɑːk. ɪts ðə ˈmoʊst ˈɪntrəstɪŋ ˈsɪti aɪv ˈɛvər ˈlɪvd ˈɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? What do you like about it?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwʌt duː juː ˈlaɪk əˈbaʊt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: The atmosphere! And the old town is fascinating.
dialogue.reading: ði ˈætməsfɪr! ənd ði ˈoʊld ˈtaʊn ɪz ˈfæsəneɪtɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I agree. The historic buildings there are beautiful.
dialogue.reading: aɪ əˈɡriː. ðə hɪˈstɔːrɪk ˈbɪldɪŋz ˈðɛr ər ˈbjuːtəfəl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: The architecture of the temples is amazing, too. Wat Pho is the most beautiful temple I've ever seen.
dialogue.reading: ði ˈɑːrkɪtɛktʃər əv ðə ˈtɛmpəlz ɪz əˈmeɪzɪŋ, ˈtuː. ˈwɑːt ˈpoʊ ɪz ðə ˈmoʊst ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈtɛmpəl aɪv ˈɛvər ˈsiːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What's the best place you've ever lived?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌts ðə ˈbɛst ˈpleɪs juːv ˈɛvər ˈlɪvd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Before Bangkok? My hometown, I think. It's small, but it has a lovely atmosphere.
dialogue.reading: bɪˈfɔːr ˈbæŋkɑːk? maɪ ˈhoʊmtaʊn, aɪ ˈθɪŋk. ɪts ˈsmɔːl, bʌt ɪt ˈhæz ə ˈlʌvli ˈætməsfɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And what's the best food you've ever had?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌts ðə ˈbɛst ˈfuːd juːv ˈɛvər ˈhæd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's easy. Your mom's green curry!
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈiːzi. jʊr ˈmɑːmz ˈɡriːn ˈkɜːri!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I'll tell her. She'll be so happy!
dialogue.reading: aɪl ˈtɛl hɜːr. ʃiːl bi ˈsoʊ ˈhæpi!
